physical_scope: Same thermal finite-Matsubara action, actual dual mesh, uniform superconducting contacts; smooth amplitude and angular phase probes. No photon or nonthermal population evolution.
numerical_scope: Real inherited local KWT first-order Euler update; uniform linearized analytic stability bound and independent dt/2 comparison; integrated free-energy dissipation.
acceptance: 2 percent of initial same-observable signal plus declared absolute floor; do not normalize by extinguished tails. Integrated dissipation 2 percent initial excess energy plus1e-8. Completed diagnostics retained even when a margin is missed. Balance and positive energy excursions are checked over the entire accepted history, not only the final state.
source_hash_policy: Experimental/runner bytes exact; production core hash is Git HEAD LF blob, matching Linux execution bytes.
checkpoint_scope: Every common accepted primary/refined time is saved with fields, physical time, accumulated loss and step counts. Recovery is explicit follow-up work; this runner does not promise automatic resume.
